bullets.text: The meeting goal was to lock the Q1 roadmap with capacity for three major projects.
The candidate projects were offline mode, Salesforce integration, reporting dashboard redesign, and enterprise SSO.
Enterprise SSO was prioritized first as it blocks two deals worth $180k in annual revenue.
Engineering estimates the SSO build requires four weeks with SAML and OIDC support.
Offline mode was assigned a two-week technical spike in January due to an estimated eight-week build time and sync engine rewrite risks.
The full offline mode build will only proceed if the technical spike looks good.
Salesforce integration was moved to Q2 because only eleven customers requested it and Zapier covers most use cases.
The reporting dashboard redesign took the third slot due to churn interview feedback, but a designer is needed as Emma is booked until mid-January.

Mục tiêu của cuộc họp là chốt lộ trình Q1 với khả năng thực hiện khoảng ba dự án lớn.
Các ứng viên được đề xuất bao gồm chế độ hoạt động trực tuyến (offline mode), tích hợp Salesforce, thiết kế lại bảng điều khiển báo cáo và SSO cho doanh nghiệp.

sections.heading: Quyết định ưu tiên và phân bổ nguồn lực

bullets.text: Dự án SSO cho doanh nghiệp được ưu tiên nhất vì nó chặn hai hợp đồng trị giá 180.000 USD/năm và thời gian ước tính là bốn tuần với hỗ trợ SAML và OIDC.
Chế độ offline mode cần viết lại động cơ đồng bộ hóa (sync engine) gây rủi ro, nên được đề xuất chạy thử nghiệm hai tuần trước khi xây dựng đầy đủ.
Quyết định chính thức: SSO là ưu tiên số một; chế độ offline mode chạy thử nghiệm kỹ thuật trong tháng 1, chỉ xây dựng hoàn toàn nếu thử nghiệm thành công.
Tích hợp Salesforce được chuyển sang Q2 vì chỉ có mười một khách hàng yêu cầu và Zapier hiện đã đáp ứng phần lớn nhu cầu.
Thiết kế lại bảng điều khiển báo cáo nhận vị trí thứ ba do các cuộc phỏng vấn giảm churn nhắc đến việc báo cáo; cần thiết kế viên Emma nhưng bà ấy bận đến giữa tháng 1.

Vấn đề còn mở: Việc thuê hợp tác viên cho thiết kế bảng điều khiển báo cáo chưa được xác nhận.
The payment outage lasted 47 minutes from 9:12 to 9:59 AM on Monday.
Approximately 2,300 orders failed, resulting in an estimated $95,000 in delayed revenue.
The outage was triggered by an expired TLS certificate installed manually two years ago at 9:12 AM.
Monitoring detected the error within three minutes, but diagnosis took most of the 47 minutes while the certificate replacement took eight minutes.
Jordan will own moving all certificates to automated renewal by the end of next week and adding a 30-day expiration alert.

Nguyên nhân gốc rễ là việc migration thêm index cho bảng orders trên production vào giờ cao điểm đã khóa bảng gần 40 phút và làm cạn connection pool.
The meeting was held to review an incident where the app went down for approximately two hours from 20:00 to 22:00 on November 5th.
Approximately 12,000 users were affected, primarily unable to log in or place orders.
The root cause was a database migration adding an index to the orders table on production during peak hours, which locked the table for nearly 40 minutes and depleted the connection pool.
The migration ran quickly on staging because it only contained a few thousand rows, whereas production had 30 million rows.
An alert was triggered at 20:05 but not received by the on-call team due to a misconfigured PagerDuty phone number; customer feedback on the fanpage was only seen at 20:50.
Decision made to require concurrent index creation for large table migrations and to schedule them after 23:00.
Vy will write a migration checklist including a mandatory DBA review step, to be completed before this Friday.
Sơn will add circuit breakers for database calls and limit retries to three times with exponential backoff.
The on-call configuration will be reviewed by the team today, and monthly alert testing will be implemented.
The CS team will send apology emails with a 50,000 voucher to affected users; Lan from CS will be notified.
Sơn proposed conducting load tests with production-like data before major releases, which was agreed upon with details to be discussed in the next meeting.

The meeting was held to conduct a postmortem for the app outage on Wednesday, November 5th.
The app was down for approximately 2 hours (from 20:00 to 22:00), affecting about 12,000 users who could not log in or place orders.

The root cause was a database migration adding an index to the orders table on production during peak hours, which locked the table for nearly 40 minutes because the production table had 30 million rows.
The connection pool was exhausted, and other services retrying continuously caused further database overload.
An alert was triggered at 20:05, but the on-call person did not receive it due to an incorrect phone number configuration in PagerDuty.
The issue was only discovered at 20:50 through customer complaints on the fanpage.
All migrations on large tables must use 'create index concurrently' and be executed outside of peak hours (after 23:00).

Khoảng 12 nghìn user bị ảnh hưởng, chủ yếu không đăng nhập được và không đặt hàng được
Root cause là migration database thêm index cho bảng orders, chạy trên production lúc cao điểm, khóa bảng gần 40 phút
Connection pool bị cạn, các service khác retry liên tục nên làm database quá tải thêm
The meeting is about the postmortem of the app's outage on November 5th.
Approximately 12,000 users were affected, mainly unable to log in and place orders.
The root cause of the outage was the migration of the database to add an index to the orders table, which was run on production during peak hours and locked the table for nearly 40 minutes.
The migration ran quickly on staging because it only had a few thousand rows, whereas production had 30 million rows.
The connection pool was also depleted, causing other services to retry continuously and overload the database further.
The team discussed why it took 2 hours to recover from the outage.
The alert was sent at 8:05 PM, but the on-call person did not receive it due to a misconfigured phone number in PagerDuty.
It took until 9:50 PM for someone to notice the issue through customer feedback on the fanpage.
Action: All migrations on large tables must use create index concurrently and run outside peak hours, starting from 23:00.
Vy will write a migration checklist and add a mandatory review step by the DBA, to be completed by this Friday.
Sơn will add a circuit breaker for services calling the database and limit retries to a maximum of 3 with exponential backoff.
Sơn will recheck the PagerDuty on-call configuration for the team today, and Đức will test alerts every month.
The team CS will send an email apology with a 50,000 VND voucher to affected users, and Sơn will inform Lan from CS.
Sơn suggests conducting load testing with production-like data before each major release.
Đức agrees to load testing, and Sơn will plan it, with further discussion at the next meeting.
